description: Source code for the mod_maxminddb plugin, a MaxMind GeoIP2 support module for lighttpd web server, including configuration, database handling, and request processing functions.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with function pointers and plugin name.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_open_db
methods.description: Opens and validates the MaxMind database file.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_prep_cenv
methods.description: Prepares environment variable mappings for MaxMind DB queries.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual configuration plugin values into plugin config.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to request context.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin.

methods.name: geoip2_env_set
methods.description: Sets environment variables based on MaxMind DB data.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_geoip2
methods.description: Performs GeoIP2 lookup and sets environment variables.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_request_env_handler
methods.description: Handles request to set environment variables based on GeoIP lookup.

methods.name: mod_maxminddb_handle_con_close
methods.description: Cleans up connection-specific context on connection close.
